transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm ready to review the production rollout proposal for the critical authentication gateway patch. Before I can give final approval, I need to make sure we've covered the change-control checklist — specifically review from platform engineering, customer operations, and compliance. I'd also like to hear any operational constraints from the team and discuss how the plan will incorporate them. Who wants to start?

transcript.text: I need to share an important operational constraint. While testing the patch against the service inventory this afternoon, I confirmed that exactly 18 legacy services cannot restart safely until a compatibility bridge has run for 6 hours. I haven't updated the rollout proposal yet because the test finished after the planning meeting. This means the current proposal — targeting all production regions after a 10 percent canary — doesn't account for this compatibility requirement, and we need to factor it into the plan before proceeding.

transcript.text: I need to share a compliance constraint I identified today. During a compliance evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that this patch requires a signed deployment manifest and immutable retention of its rollout evidence for exactly 180 days. I haven't filed the evidence requirement yet because the security finding was only classified this afternoon. The current rollout proposal — which records ordinary deployment logs — does not meet this requirement, and we'll need to incorporate signed manifests and immutable 180-day evidence retention before I can sign off on the compliance review.
